migration: Replaces studio-specific coordination claims with row-derived counts, predecessor evidence, shared-resource checks and pitch review. Start a new baseline at this version.
gameProfile: Owner-approved pack.profile defines the game facts, scope and budgets
levels: Score the share of observed cases meeting each condition against the profile floor, pass share and target.
verdict: Open P0s and confirmed release blockers set the grade to 0. Missing observations reduce coverage. Invalid packs have a null grade.
samplePolicy: Every line reads uniquely keyed sample rows from its own receipt. Empty lists and zero measured cases give U and earn 0 points. Fractions use all eligible observed opportunities.
source: An owner-approved ledger export, task graph, time and capacity estimates, discipline receipts, approved pitch facts and a reviewed local deck.

anchors.0: No measured case meets this condition: each sampled deliverable has a role, done condition and named verification source.
anchors.1: Some cases meet the condition, below the profile floor.
anchors.2: The observed share reaches the floor and falls short of the pass share.
anchors.3: The observed share reaches the pass share and falls short of the target.
anchors.4: At least the target share of cases shows this outcome: each sampled deliverable has a role, done condition and named verification source.
anchors.U: UNMEASURED. The receipt, population, required observation or approved budget is missing, stale or unusable.
